items.title: Unpatched AhsayCBS Vulnerabilities Exploited in the Wild
items.summary: The flaws, CVE-2026-105133 and CVE-2026-105134, allow attackers to bypass authentication and inject OS commands. The post Unpatched AhsayCBS Vulnerabilities Exploited in the Wild appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.summary_zh: 這些漏洞（CVE-2026-105133 和 CVE-2026-105134）允許攻擊者繞過身分驗證並注入作業系統指令。這篇《未修補的 AhsayCBS 漏洞於野外遭利用》文章首次出現於 SecurityWeek。

items.title: FBI disrupts Chinese hacking tools used to breach critical infrastructure
items.summary: The FBI has seized seven domains used by Chinese state-sponsored hackers known as Flax Typhoon to operate two hacking tools, MicroScan and FishHub, used in attacks that breached critical infrastructure and other organizations worldwide. [...]
items.title_zh: FBI 打擊中國駭客用以入侵關鍵基礎設施的工具
